title: Warning on claim farming involving people eligible for government redress
summary: The VLSB+C has issued guidance warning that lawyer involvement in claim farming is unacceptable. It warns this can amount to unsatisfactory professional conduct or professional misconduct.
what_changes: Sets out the regulator's expectations of lawyers acting for people eligible for redress, with examples of good and bad practice.
Warns about cold-call claim farming aimed at abuse victim-survivors and Stolen Generations members, with claims sold on to lawyers.
Raises concern about misleading clients into thinking they need a lawyer, or hiding that a referrer was paid.
The regulator states it will treat complaints about overcharging in redress matters seriously.
who_it_applies_to: Victorian lawyers and law practices that act for, or are referred, people eligible for government redress schemes.

history.event: VLSB+C issued guidance and a warning on lawyer involvement in claim farming of redress claims.
